Backups bleiben auf dem alten Rechner. S: Backups stay on the old machine. Its server folder is kept as a safety net and can be deleted there under Settings → Storage.
Der Server wird dafür gestoppt. Lief er,: The server is stopped for this. If it was running, it starts again on the new machine.
Die Ports können sich ändern, wenn sie d: The ports may change if they are already taken there. Players then need the new address.
Die Spieldateien lädt der neue Rechner n: The new machine downloads the game files again (like when creating a server). Depending on the game this can take a while.
zieht mit Spielständen, Einstellungen, A: moves to another machine with saves, settings, tasks, events, history and player statistics.
Das Umzugspaket stammt von einer neueren: The move package comes from a newer panel version. Please update here first
Das ist kein Umzugspaket des Panels: This is not a panel move package
Der Rechner dieses Servers antwortet ger: The machine of this server is not answering right now
Der Rechner hat keinen Server gemeldet: The machine did not report a server
Der Server ist schon auf diesem Rechner: The server is already on this machine
Der Ziel-Rechner antwortet gerade nicht: The target machine is not answering right now
Diesen Umzug gibt es nicht (mehr): This move does not exist (any more)
Server wird für den Umzug gestoppt: Stopping the server for the move
Download-Dateien fehlen oder sind beschä: Download files are missing or damaged. The panel resets the download state and checks all files on the next attempt.
Steam bricht den Download ab. Meist erre: Steam aborts the download. Usually the machine cannot reach Steam's download servers (DNS filters like AdGuard or Pi-hole, firewall, proxy); less often an old download state is stuck. The panel resets that itself on the next attempt.
Steam hat den Download abgelehnt oder un: Steam refused or interrupted the download. Try again later.
Steam kann nicht auf die Platte schreibe: Steam cannot write to the disk (usually file permissions in the server folder).
Steam konnte die App nicht aktualisieren: Steam could not update the app. Another attempt often helps; if not, check the internet connection and Steam status.
keine Verbindung zu Steam. Meist ein kur: no connection to Steam. Usually a short outage at Steam; try again later.
unbekannter Steam-Fehler. Die Zeilen mit: unknown Steam error. The lines with [steam] in the console show Steam's own messages.
